question: After hanging 87 points on Savannah State, are the Bulldogs the class of HBCU football right now?

stances.renee-vaughn: MODERATOR: take NO side; referee and press both debaters on what the 87-0 win really means and how it compares to other contenders.
stances.cassius-wynn: YES, South Carolina State Bulldogs are the class of HBCU football right now because their historic 87-0 win sets a new standard and signals dominance unmatched since the 2025 Idaho State blowout.
stances.andrew-hammond: NO, despite the 87-0 win, it’s too soon to call the Bulldogs the class of HBCU football without seeing how they perform against stronger competition like Florida A&M.

withheld.instruction: NOW detonate this receipt, flat, let it sit.

protected_facts.note: Head coach Chennis Berry is aiming to prove last season's Celebration Bowl championship was not a fluke.

waypoints.note: Highlight the historical significance of the 87-0 margin and challenge the notion that the opponent’s weakness diminishes the Bulldogs’ dominance.
Counter by emphasizing that the real test is upcoming against Florida A&M, so this win alone doesn’t crown them.
Push back by arguing that the Bulldogs’ No. 24 FCS ranking and record-breaking performance already place them atop HBCU football.
Respond with caution about rankings and remind that South Carolina State must prove consistency beyond one game.
Assert that the Bulldogs’ Celebration Bowl championship and this dominant start make them the clear class of HBCU football now.
Reiterate that until they face Florida A&M, the claim remains unproven and premature.

detonation_react.instruction: You didn't see that historical margin coming; react with surprise, then argue that even historic wins don’t guarantee current supremacy.

kk_drop.instruction: Take the floor for your ONE weight-drop: name the thing the others have been circling without seeing. Two or three sentences, NEW words only, unhurried, air around it. End by reframing the question itself.

opener.instruction: State the Bulldogs scored 87 points in their season opener against Savannah State, setting a school record, then stop.

exit.instruction: Button the segment by acknowledging the Bulldogs’ statement game but concede the debate is wide open until Florida A&M; tease next week’s showdown.
